video.title: AI欧腐《别让继兄知道我是个猫男/Don't Tell My Stepbrother I'm a Catboy》
video.desc:
I'm a Catboy I’m the cursed catboy whose magic massages make fighters win. But the man I love is my stepbrother who raised me. When love turns forbidden, and a ruthless syndicate closes in, can we escape danger? 

我是一个被诅咒的猫男，我的魔法按摩能让拳手战无不胜。可我爱上的人，偏偏是一手把我带大的继兄。当这份爱成为禁忌，心狠手辣的犯罪集团又步步紧逼，我们能否逃出险境？
